string.text: Barrel with thread for silencer
Allows you to install a silencer of the appropriate caliber on a weapon.
Re-rifling the barrel
Changing the pitch of the rifling in the bore of a weapon allows you to increase the initial speed of the bullet and reduce the spread of hits when firing.
Barrel adjustment
Allows you to reduce the spread of bullets when firing a weapon, which increases the accuracy and accuracy of fire.
Modification of the cartridge supply unit
Individual fitting of the power supply parts allows you to reduce the likelihood of delays during shooting associated with non-feeding and misalignment of the cartridge.
Refinement of the extractor
Allows you to reduce the number of delays associated with the sticking of cartridges ejected from the pistol after firing.It has a beneficial effect on the reliability of the weapon.
Combined tactical module
Combines the functions of a highly targeted tactical flashlight and a laser target designator.Particularly useful at night.
Anatomical handle
Created taking into account the individual characteristics and preferences of the shooter, making the grip of the weapon much more convenient and shooting more comfortable.
Lightweight handle
Allows you to slightly reduce the weight of the weapon.It's a small thing, but nice.And true convenience, as we know, comes from the little things.
Protective coating
Applying a special coating to weapon parts can significantly slow down its wear.
Rail fastening
Installing an additional rail on a weapon expands the possibilities of its tactical use, opening up the possibility of installing additional modules.
Soft trigger trigger
Allows you to reduce recoil, facilitating more accurate shooting.
Lightweight magazine
Replacing a standard weapon magazine with a lightweight one allows you to slightly reduce the total weight.
Light alloy parts

Replacing parts in the main components of the weapon with their light-alloy counterparts makes it possible to reduce the weight of the weapon without significant harm to its other tactical and technical characteristics.
Refinement of the chamber
Eliminating backlash makes it possible to improve the obturation, which results in a higher initial bullet speed.
Tritium inserts
Installing luminous inserts in sights allows you to increase the speed of aiming and the convenience of firing in the dark.
Forcing USM
Reconfiguring the trigger and modifying some of its parts allows the shooter to fire at a higher rate.Unfortunately, this causes the weapon to wear out a little faster.
Shutter Balancing
Balancing the bolt group parts reduces the barrel moving away from the line of sight when firing and reduces felt recoil.
Lightweight frame
Replacing a standard weapon frame with a lightweight analogue allows you to gain weight in the weapon, without losing in reliability and other characteristics.
Recoil compensation system
A radical reworking of the weapon's trigger can significantly reduce the recoil felt when firing.
